data.one_liner: Renders interactive 3D models in GLB, GLTF, OBJ, and FBX formats.
data.what_it_does: Renders interactive 3D models in various formats such as GLB, GLTF, and OBJ inside Flutter applications. Provides a controller to manage animations, textures, camera targets, camera orbits, and rotation speed.
use_when: You need to display interactive 3D models in GLB, GLTF, or OBJ formats.
You need programmatic control over 3D model animations, textures, and camera positioning.
avoid_when: You require complex 3D game engines or advanced physics simulations.
You are working on platforms other than Android, iOS, Web, and macOS.
strengths: Supports multiple 3D formats including GLB, GLTF, and OBJ.
Includes a gesture interceptor feature to prevent gesture conflicts on mobile devices.
Provides a robust controller for managing animations, textures, and camera orbits.
weaknesses: macOS support is currently in beta.
Relies on external platform configurations like internet permissions and web script imports.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding internet permissions and build configuration for Android, embedded views preview on iOS, a script tag in web/index.html, and Outgoing Connections capability on macOS.
